mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 1.0% change) signals an easing monetary policy that compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 40% of instances where the 3-month change in FEDFUNDS is negative, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%, it signals a potential for monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 40% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is rising and the year-over-year change in CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%, it signals a tightening monetary cycle that leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rising and CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.0%
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in less than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS is rising and CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 6.0%), the S&P 500 produces positive returns over the next 20 trading days due to expectations of accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 40% of instances where UNRATE > 6.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strong consumer demand, supporting corporate earnings growth and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in less than 40% of instances where the 3-month change in HOUST is positive, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 95.0 (index 2017=100), it signals a potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in less than 40% of instances where INDPRO < 95.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) and residential fixed investment (RSAFS) both show a 3-month increase, it signals strong demand for housing and consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 40% of instances where HOUST and RSAFS both have 3-month change > 0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a low industrial production regime (INDPRO < 95.0), the S&P 500 produces negative returns over the next 60 trading days due to concerns about economic slowdown.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in less than 40% of instances where INDPRO < 95.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
